Wendland/Cubic Symplectic; vertical finite gz<0, gx=gy=0; InitNone; no load/drain/fixed-grid drainage; constant conductivity model0,Ck0.

No HG, independent SPR, softening, SoilDamping or damping zone; constant artificial AV only (no ViscoTime), DDTNone, no artificial stress or Shepard; corrected stress/pore gradients and PairDivergence remain mandatory.
existing_checks_preserved: The shared positive DtFixed/PoreDtSafety/CFL and backend material/J/saturation/step checks remain active. Existing finite nonnegative constant-AV validation is reused; only its allowed scope adds the derived container predicate. No physics guard deleted. Old common InitDynamicWall array/mass/finite checks run BEFORE the container geometry branch, then old parallel/column/private routes are untouched.
geometry: AFTER existing RunInitialize/ConfigBoundNormals calls, before first forces: shared host input uses real CPU Posc/Codec/Velrhopc/normals/slip and real GPU AuxPos/Code/Velrhop/normals/slip. All native counts complete, equal positive reference mass, finite positive Dp/R and finite stationary fixed geometry required. Group by normal direction +X,-X,+Z, not by MK, so opposite FreeSlip faces can share MK. Exactly one coplanar location per direction; side FS, bottom NS; all three directions present; X gap>2*KernelSize. Original8*FLT_EPSILON axis-direction and1e-6*Dp plane thresholds reused, no fitting.
soil_and_far_bed: Only initial normal native soil must lie inside the three physical interface half-spaces. Fixed bed can extend outside left/right span; no whole-box check of fixed B/mirror targets, no global projection/activation and no far-wall fit. Existing each-state current-support union, OFF and nearest-source retry remain unchanged. Proximity does not prove wet/contact eligibility.
rejections: Reject top/downward-Z walls, inclined/nonstationary/zero/nonfinite normals, mixed slip incompatible with the three directions, noncoplanar faces, missing side/bed, overlapping opposing supports, initial out-of-container soil, moving/floating/restart/periodic and all unported options above. Geometry supplied by real data, no case name or numeric 7060/5000/2060/4/2/12 restrictions.
numerical_consequence: Only admits the already ported state/C/Ace/Darcy/momentum path into actual fresh Pre/Corr for bounded elastic gravity diagnostics; no equation, time integrator, field, kernel or constitutive policy changed. Real plasticity remains unaccepted and existing nonzero-Kplastic rejection stays. DefaultOFF, old periodic/column/freebody arithmetic unaffected.
not_physical_acceptance: No-drain gravity warmup is NOT the paper free-seepage/in-situ preparation and does not release the retaining wall, plastic/apex treatment, evolved k, negative-pore boundary, curved/moving/3D walls or full collapse. Actual same-geometry CPU/GPU Pre/Corr still requires reviewed execution and native safety; no new test launched.
